result:
Final characterisation on the shipped tape: 57 ok, 0 failed, exit 0.

---

**Root cause:** `updateTerminal` (`variants/bug07/movegen.inc`) decided mate-vs-stalemate by calling `moverInCheck`, which ignores its `A` argument and reports on the side that *just moved* — never in check after a legal move — so every position with no legal replies fell through to the stalemate branch; the correct predicate is `inCheckSide(sideToMove)`.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug07/movegen.inc` — `call moverInCheck` → `call inCheckSide` + explanatory comment (one byte of the 13516-byte image changes: offset 4832, `0x5F`→`0x47`)
- `variants/bug07/test_terminal.py` — new, 10-case regression test
- `variants/bug07/Makefile` — new `test-terminal` target, invoked from `test`
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root

**Gate status**
- Reported symptom reproduces: PASS (all 3 repros + 2 controls reproduced before the fix)
- Symptom gone: PASS — `Ra1-a8` → `Checkmate! White wins` / black-mated; `Ra8-a1` → `Checkmate! Black wins` / white-mated; `Qf1-f8` → checkmate; stalemate control still stalemate; check control still `play`
- `make test` (variants/bug07): PASS, 24 s — golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft self-test, save/load round-trip, 128K banked TT, terminal test 10/10
- New test: PASS 10/10 on the fixed build; 7/10 red on a rebuilt pre-fix tape (whose md5 matches the originally committed `chess.tap`), so it would have caught the bug
- Characterisation suite: PASS — 57 ok / 0 failed / exit 0 on the fixed build; the pre-fix build fails exactly 3 (`tm_fools_mate`, `tm_scholars_mate`, `se_mate_in_one`), so the whole behavioural delta of the fix is those mates
- 128K spot-check (`--machine hc128`): PASS
- Review: 1 round, synchronous, verdict **NO DEFECT IN THE FIX** — gate closed. All 8 findings were NON-BLOCKING; 6 adopted anyway (3 extra test cases including the `aiMove`-no-root-move path, plus doc corrections and test hygiene), 2 left open. Per-finding disposition in `FIX_NOTES.md` §5.

**Knowingly left open**
- Castling mate and take-back-then-replay mate: verified working by the reviewer, not folded into `make test` to keep it short.
- Three pre-existing defects unrelated to this bug and identical on the pristine build (already-terminal position loaded with the human to move is never classified; take-back leaves phantom `moveLog` entries; `afterMove` records a phantom undo entry when the engine has no move). Fixing them would diverge from the pristine behaviour the characterisation suite pins.

Note for re-running the suite: `characterise.py`'s default harness path points outside this workspace — use `--harness ../harness`.
